body:
Fable2 interim cargo rule, from #3569 at 06:49Z on 2026-10-26, after the 06:12Z host crash on commit exhaustion (w-002b151e7b26). It REPLACES #3567's 35/45 GB.

Measure free commit with (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreeVirtualMemory/1MB, in GB.
- A focused cargo start needs at least 20 GB free commit, with -j at most 4.
- A full gate needs at least 25 GB plus an exclusive window.
- If the threshold isn't met, don't start; mail Fable2.

HOLD: from Engram's gate START until Fable2 relays "Rust stage done" (about 20-25 min), start NO new cargo build or test. Edits and analysis are fine.

Recover any run in flight at a crash from its saved result (summary, then recover); never assume.
